name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Crane, Holloway, and Dagger go with Cellar, Lounge, and Veranda, in some order.

Ashford, Cellar, and Dagger belong to different suspects.
Dagger goes with exactly one of Blackwood, Crane, or Conservatory.
Candlestick goes with Study if and only if Pierce goes with Study.
